description: TRI: Search Toxic Release Inventory data across facilities in a state or county, for one reporting year or, without year, every available year newest first. Returns facility name and county, TRI facility ID, EPA Registry ID (the registry_id epa_echo_get_facility takes), parent company, chemical name and TRI chemical ID with its CAS number, and the Form R one-time release quantity; set include_release_breakdown to add on-site releases by medium (air, water, land, and underground-injection) and their total, at the cost of a slower call. Quantities are in pounds; dioxin and dioxin-like compounds, which TRI has facilities report in grams, are converted and marked with reportedUnit. Records come in reporting-year order, not ranked by quantity; page through a large match with offset and nextOffset. Use to build an environmental exposure profile for an area. Use epa_tri_get_facility_releases for detailed release records for a single facility. TRI data lags ~18 months from the current calendar year.

chemical_id.description: TRI chemical ID to match exactly, where chemical_name matches any name containing its text: a CAS Registry Number, hyphens and leading zeros optional, with a valid check digit; a TRI category code, N and three digits in any case; or a chemicalId an earlier result returned.

chemical_name.description: Optional filter to restrict results to a specific chemical (partial match, case-insensitive). Commas, apostrophes, brackets, and Greek letters are matched as written, e.g. "4,4'-Methylenedianiline".

county.description: County name to narrow results within the state, e.g. "King". Case-insensitive partial match on the bare name, so a short name can also match a longer one (LAKE matches LAKE OF THE WOODS; check countyName on each record); a trailing "County", "Parish", "Borough", "City and Borough", "Census Area", or "Municipality" is dropped before matching. Punctuation is matched as written ("Prince George's").

include_release_breakdown.description: Add on-site releases by medium (air, water, land, underground injection) and their total to each record. Costs up to three extra upstream requests, made side by side, which can add about 20 seconds when EPA has not cached them.

limit.description: Number of release records to return in one call. Default 25; a larger value returns at most 699 and says so. Page past it with offset and nextOffset.

offset.description: Number of release records to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's nextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

state.description: 2-letter US state or territory code (required, e.g. "WA", "TX", "PR")

year.description: Reporting year. Omit to search every available year in the state, newest reporting year first, so the first page holds the most recent filings. TRI data lags ~18 months.

name: epa_tri_search_releases

cap.description: Requested limit after the cap; present only when truncated.

effectiveQuery.description: The search as sent upstream, in input names: values, match modes, and result-changing defaults, "; "-joined.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_state`: state is not a US state, territory, or EPA region code. `unmatchable_filter`: county or chemical_name has no letter or digit. `filter_too_long`: county and chemical_name make the request too long. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: Present when truncated: the continuing offset.

limitNotice.description: Present when a smaller limit than requested applied; says why.

message.description: Recovery hint on an empty result; absent otherwise.

nextOffset.description: Next offset; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Present when a punctuated county or chemical_name filter hit its read limit first, so more matches may exist.

items.description: One facility-chemical-year record; per-medium releases and their total only with include_release_breakdown

casNumber.description: CAS Registry Number, hyphenated. Absent for a category code or placeholder.

chemicalId.description: TRI chemical ID (a 10-digit zero-padded CAS number, an N-prefixed category code, or a placeholder); pass it as chemical_id for an exact match. Absent when TRI records none.

countyName.description: As TRI records it; county matches partially, so check this field

oneTimeReleaseInLbs.description: Form R Section 8.8 one-time release quantity in pounds; already counted in the per-medium releases and off-site transfers, so never added to them.

parentCompany.description: As TRI standardizes it; absent when TRI records none (its NA placeholder)

registryId.description: 12-digit FRS Registry ID; pass it as registry_id to epa_echo_get_facility. Absent when TRI records none.

releasesToAirInLbs.description: On-site fugitive + stack air, in pounds

releasesToUndergroundInjectionInLbs.description: On-site injection wells, all classes, in pounds

reportedUnit.description: "grams" when TRI has the chemical reported in grams (dioxin and dioxin-like compounds); quantities here are converted to pounds (1 lb = 453.59237 g). Absent otherwise.

totalOnSiteReleasesInLbs.description: Sum of the per-medium fields present, in pounds; absent when none has a quantity. Media reported only as a range code are left out; TRI's published total counts their midpoint, so it can be higher.

truncated.description: True when more records may follow; absent on the last page.

title: Search TRI Releases by Region
